text:

⏰  08:30–16:00 CDT
🏨  Harry Hachey Conference Center, SABS

title: Spatiotemporal Modelling for Index Standardization
text:
Learning Objectives
Through guided modules, you will learn to:

Prepare complex fisheries data for spatiotemporal analysis.
Configure models in both sdmTMB and VAST frameworks.
Interpret spatial and spatiotemporal random effects.
Diagnose model fit quality using DHARMa and other modern tools.
Hands-on Application: Apply the mastered workflows directly to your own research datasets.

title: Workshop Schedule
text:
Technical Notes

Software: Ensure R, RStudio, sdmTMB, VAST, and tinyVAST are installed before Monday 08:30.
Projections: Ensure you have the sf package to handle coordinate transformations (WGS84 to UTM).
Data: Participants working on their own data should have their CSV or RData files ready for Lab 1.
